name: Whodunit
scope: Yes if it is a detective or crime novel, or a famous sleuth's debut
boundary: Whodunit: invented crimes and sleuths; real police and prisons go to Crime & Punishment, horror to Fright Night, spies to Spy Games.
example_beats: Poe's Murders in the Rue Morgue (1841)
Poirot debuts in The Mysterious Affair at Styles (1920)
The Big Sleep introduces Philip Marlowe (1939)
